V1.scale: Measured: stack overflows between 512 and 1024 nesting levels at 256 KB stack cap; CPU time and allocation are flat (not depth-dependent). Estimated per-frame cost ~277 bytes (with ~60 KB base stack for JVM/framework/reader chain). Extrapolating to 1 MB evaluation stack: ~3500 nesting levels cause StackOverflowError. Encoding: 2 bytes per nesting level (one open + one close paren) plus 54 bytes boilerplate. For 3500 levels: 7056 bytes.
